dish: Sapporo miso ramen (three-white-miso blend, Kōchi ginger)
w: The miso-ramen counter Sapporo queues for — three white misos over a clear pork-bone broth, a dab of grated ginger on the chāshū. Michelin Bib Gourmand (Hokkaido 2017) and Tabelog Ramen Hokkaido 100 (2024).

n: Sumire Susukino (すみれ 札幌すすきの店)
address: Pixis Bldg 2F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 3-9-2, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 064-0803, Japan
w: The Murakami family house (1964) that codified the lard-sealed, scalding Sapporo miso bowl; the late-night Susukino branch pours the Nakanoshima honten broth. Tabelog Ramen Hokkaido 100 2024 & 2025.

dish: miso ramen with house-made Hokkaido-wheat noodles
w: Additive-free broths and house-made noodles from Hokkaido wheat since 2006 — the gyokai-tonkotsu shōyu and the miso both draw lines. Michelin Bib Gourmand (Hokkaido 2017).

address: Crystal Bldg 1F, Minami 5-jō Nishi 4, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 064-0805, Japan
w: The Susukino jingisukan room since 1954 — a cast-iron dome at every seat, one cut of mutton, sweet-spicy dipping sauce, a queue from 17:30. Cash only.

n: Soup Curry Garaku (スープカレー GARAKU)
address: Okumura Bldg B1F, Minami 2-jō Nishi 2-6-1, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0062, Japan
w: Numbered tickets and daily lines for a soup curry whose broth borrows udon-shop dashi technique — pork bone and herbs stewed two days, kelp and bonito layered in.

dish: soup curry with Hokkaido vegetables and red-rice blend
address: Minami 4-jō Nishi (〒064-0804), Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan — a few minutes from Susukino Station
w: Locals' favourite Susukino soup curry: skewered roast chicken, stewed pork and a pile of local vegetables, with rice cut with red rice. 11:30–22:00 daily.

n: Oiso, Nijō Market (二条市場 大磯)
address: Sapporo Nijō Market, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The classic first stop in 'Sapporo's kitchen' — morning queues for donburi of sea urchin, salmon roe and crab, ¥2,000–3,000.

n: Donburi Chaya, Nijō Market (どんぶり茶屋)
address: Sapporo Nijō Market, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Born in Nijō Market, a specialist with over fifty kaisendon — all-crab, all-shrimp, uni-ikura-crab-scallop-botan-ebi — plus grilled-seafood bowls.
